newsitem.title: USA: ICG exchange tariff approved in Colorado.
newsitem.headline: ICG exchange tariff approved in Colorado.

text.p: ICG Communications Inc said its wholly owned unit, ICG Telecom Group Inc., received local telephone service tariff approval by the Colorado Public Utilities Commission (PUC), allowing ICG to become a fully competitive local exchange carrier in Colorado.
The tariff sets forth the rates, terms and conditions under which ICG will provide local telephone services within the state.
"For the past few years we have been preparing for this day and it represents a bright spot in our company's history," said Bill Maxwell, president of ICG Telecom Group.

Maxwell noted that an aggressive marketing campaign, currently being tested in California, would soon appear in Colorado media. The company will be marketing its local dial tone service to businesses in its targeted states and regions in early 1997.

The Colorado PUC also recently approved an interconnection agreement between ICG and U S West Communications Group, in compliance with the Telecommunications Act of 1996. This agreement provides for interconnection, resale and unbundling of U S West facilities as well as local number portability.
